channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Northrop Grumman to build US Navy lightweight torpedo
item.description: Northrop Grumman has been awarded a contract to manufacture a new advanced lightweight torpedo for the U.S. Navy, featuring a newly developed warhead intended to improve weapon effectiveness. The post Northrop Grumman to build US Navy lightweight torpedo first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: SRVL trials on HMS Prince of Wales still under analysis
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that analysis of the Royal Navy’s Shipborne Rolling Vertical Landing (SRVL) trials remains ongoing, more than two years after initial testing was carried out aboard HMS Prince of Wales. The post SRVL trials on HMS Prince of Wales still under analysis first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO leaders seek to calm fears over Greenland tensions
item.description: Senior NATO military leaders moved to project unity and reassurance in Brussels as growing concern over Greenland and Arctic security spilled into public debate. The post NATO leaders seek to calm fears over Greenland tensions first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO ready to fight tonight as SACEUR warns threats rising
item.description: NATO senior military leadership has warned that the Alliance must remain prepared to respond immediately to escalating security threats. The post NATO ready to fight tonight as SACEUR warns threats rising first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO shifts Arctic command under Norfolk headquarters
item.description: NATO has elevated the strategic importance of the High North by realigning its operational command boundaries, placing the Arctic and Nordic region under a single transatlantic command structure centred on Joint Force Command Norfolk. The post NATO shifts Arctic command under Norfolk headquarters first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy floating dock project targets early 2030s
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the long-planned additional fleet docking capability Programme Euston aims to provide new out-of-water engineering capacity at HM Naval Base Clyde in the early 2030s. The post Royal Navy floating dock project targets early 2030s first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: France seizes Russian shadow fleet tanker in Mediterranean
item.description: France has seized a tanker linked to the shadow fleet operated by Russia after a French Navy interception operation in the Mediterranean, President Emmanuel Macron has confirmed. The post France seizes Russian shadow fleet tanker in Mediterranean first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK declines assessment of US military Grok use
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has declined to assess the potential operational impact of the United States introducing new generative artificial intelligence tools such as Grok into its military networks. The post UK declines assessment of US military Grok use first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: GRAYBURN to cover weapons from pistols to machine guns
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that Project GRAYBURN, the British Army future small arms programme, will encompass the full dismounted close combat weapons portfolio, ranging from pistols through to machine guns. The post GRAYBURN to cover weapons from pistols to machine guns first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ajax programme boss sacked after safety failures
item.description: The senior official responsible for the British Army Ajax armoured vehicle programme has been removed from post following a ministerial review that found serious failures in how safety risks were reported to ministers. The post Ajax programme boss sacked after safety failures first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
